tool_args.rationale: The paid long-horizon observations confirm a transition from positive response to negative response, matching the archived dual-horizon adaptation mechanism. Fit all four parameters numerically and test on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The slow-horizon probe already supplied three discriminating observations spanning the reversal; the four-parameter dual-exponential model is now constrained.

considered_alternatives.option: single-timescale relaxation and static response models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They do not naturally explain both the short-horizon positive response and the observed long-horizon sign reversal.
The observed response scales with input and all paid rows have zero sink gradient; no evidence supports adding the unidentifiable sink parameters.
